intro: Lesson 56: Revision: upper and lower bounds. Answer every question. Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and log any errors in your repair list.

questions.q: Core: A square has side 8.6 cm to 1 d.p. Find the bounds of its perimeter and its area.
questions.a: Perimeter 34.2 to 34.6 cm; area 73.1025 to 74.8225 cm²

questions.q: Extend : d = 245 km to the nearest 5 km and t = 3.5 h to the nearest 0.1 h. Find the upper bound of the average speed.
Stretch : Find the lower bound of the speed and use both bounds to give the speed to a suitable degree of accuracy.
questions.a: 242.5 ÷ 3.55 = 68.3; both bounds round to 70 km/h to 1 s.f., so 70 km/h

questions.q: Write the bounds of 250 g to the nearest 10 g.
questions.model: Nearest 10 g: half of 10 is 5. Lower bound 250 − 5 = 245 g; upper bound 250 + 5 = 255 g.

questions.q: Find the lower bound of 12.6 + 4.3 (each 1 d.p.).
Find the upper bound of 24 ÷ 1.5 (24 to the nearest whole, 1.5 to 1 d.p.).
Write the lower bound of 3.7 m to 1 d.p.
Which bounds give the maximum of a − b?
questions.a: Upper bound of a minus lower bound of b
